nameOrigin: a type of puppet manipulated by strings

pokedexEntries.ru: BANETTE generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This POKéMON was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.

pokedexEntries.sa: A cursed energy permeated the stuffing of a discarded and forgotten plush doll, giving it new life as BANETTE. The POKéMON’s energy would escape if it were to ever open its mouth.

pokedexEntries.frlg: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a POKéMON. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.

pokedexEntries.em: An abandoned plush doll became this POKéMON. They are said to live in garbage dumps and wander about in search of the children that threw them away.

pokedexEntries.dpp: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.

pokedexEntries.hgss: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

pokedexEntries.bw: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge of being thrown away. It seeks the child who disowned it.

pokedexEntries.x: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.

pokedexEntries.y: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a Pokémon. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.

pokedexEntries.or: Banette generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This Pokémon was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.

pokedexEntries.as: A cursed energy permeated the stuffing of a discarded and forgotten plush doll, giving it new life as Banette. The Pokémon’s energy would escape if it were to ever open its mouth.

pokedexEntries.us: It’s a stuffed toy that was thrown away and became possessed, ever searching for the one who threw it away so it can exact its revenge.

pokedexEntries.um: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: A doll bore a grudge over being junked, and it became a Pokémon. It seeks the child that disowned it.
